note.question: How do upgrading options allow customers to purchase regular tickets in advance and upgrade on-site if the congestion turns out to be high?
note.overview: This paper studies advance selling and upgrading in a priority queue setting that emerges in the amusement park industry. Customers choose to buy fast-track or regular tickets depending on their heterogeneous waiting costs. At the park entrance, customers can choose tickets based on the observed congestion levels.
